paragraphs.text: Officer is a creature type introduced for Star Trek . It is used to represent a Star Fleet officer from the world of Star Trek .
Officers have been depicted on cards since Enlistment Officer ( Apocalypse ), but these usually were typed as soldiers .
For the Star Trek set, officer was chosen to be a catch-all for the different ranks on a Star Fleet ship.

In the Federation Starfleet , a (commissioned) officer is an individual who has attended and graduated from the four-year cadet program of Starfleet Academy. Upon graduation from the Academy, the cadet is granted a commission appointing them to the rank of Ensign. Professions such as Doctor or Counselor graduate as a Lieutenant junior grade as standard due to the extra time spent studying before graduating.

Starfleet ranks from lowest to highest: Ensign, Lieutenant junior grade, Lieutenant, Lieutenant commander, Commander , Captain , Fleet captain, Commodore, Rear admiral, Vice admiral, Admiral and Fleet admiral
